source_name: MNB Intézménykereső (market participant / institution register)
why_relevant: Authoritative list of every MNB-licensed or registered bank, financial enterprise, payment institution, e-money issuer, investment firm and fund manager in Hungary, plus cross-border passporting entities. This is the master ACTOR MAP for A5 — the universe of employers whose officer changes must then be tracked. Institution-level only; per my fetch it does not itself list executives.

source_name: MNB – Network of Higher Education Cooperations (felsőoktatási együttműködések hálózata)
why_relevant: Central-bank-maintained register of its university partnerships across Hungary — an off-the-shelf actor map linking finance-sector institutions to specific universities and faculties, including regional ones (Debrecen, Szeged) relevant to this cell.

source_name: MNB archívum — Hitelintézeti határozatok (legacy PSZÁF/MNB credit-institution decisions)
why_relevant: Historic archive (including PSZÁF-era H-EN-I decisions) giving multi-year backfill of executive-appointment approvals at banks and savings cooperatives — the baseline needed to compute tenure, churn rates and career paths rather than only current events.

source_name: FinTechZone — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Hungarian fintech trade-media page that amplifies and comments on Hungarian fintech/payments personnel moves; an efficient snowball hub for discovering the executives worth following individually.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség — Tagjaink (member bank directory)
why_relevant: Canonical enumeration of ~67 Hungarian credit institutions (full members, associated members, observers incl. GIRO Zrt., Magyar Államkincstár, OBA, Diákhitel Központ). Cheapest single expansion of the banking entity universe for every other A5 cell; each member has a detail page (tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=NN) that yields the institution's own site and contact person.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) — member registry
why_relevant: Canonical roster of HU bank issuers with official legal names and site links (tagId per member: 41=Raiffeisen, 47=UniCredit HU, 7=CIB, 29=MagNet). Use it to enumerate the issuer universe exhaustively so no bank's press room is missed, and to resolve official name spellings for the glossary.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség - member directory (GIRO member page)
why_relevant: The Hungarian Banking Association's member records list member institutions with named representatives; GIRO Zrt. appears as a member. The directory is a pointer to the institutional actor set and to the individuals who represent rails operators in industry bodies.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) – member directory and news
why_relevant: Authoritative roster of banks and foreign bank branches operating in Hungary (incl. Deutsche Bank AG Magyarországi Fióktelepe), giving exact legal names and aliases needed to query local media and company registries correctly for this cell.

source_name: Budapest Business Journal — Book of Lists (executive search / recruitment rankings)
why_relevant: The primary underlying dataset behind every Hungarian headhunter ranking: BBJ compiles revenue-based toplists of executive search and recruitment firms annually. Buying the Book of Lists gives a complete, ordered actor map for this cell rather than the partial top-10 reproduced in free media.

source_name: Nemzeti Cégtár (BCE Nemzeti Cégtár Nonprofit Zrt.)
why_relevant: Free searchable interface over the ~600k registered Hungarian companies with basic data plus supplementary information; convenient for resolving legal names, tax numbers and cégjegyzékszám for banks, PSPs and fintech subsidiaries before hitting the official registers.

source_name: Céginformációs Szolgálat – beszámoló-állomány értékesítése (bulk filing dataset)
why_relevant: Official route to obtain the whole filed-accounts corpus (or grouped queries over it) rather than scraping company-by-company. This is the scalable path to sector-wide headcount time series for banks and payment firms.

source_name: Nexum 'Karrier Portál' ATS tenant family (*.karrierportal.hu)
why_relevant: A single HU ATS vendor hosts many bank/financial career sites (Raiffeisen, GIRO, legacy MKB observed). Enumerating its tenants yields a ready-made list of collectable, uniformly structured vacancy feeds.

source_name: Céginfo.hu – union and employer legal-entity registry records
why_relevant: Registry lookup confirming legal existence, registration number and officers of finance-sector unions (here BBDSZ) and of bank entities. Lets you separate live actors from defunct ones and resolve name/acronym collisions before attributing statements.

source_name: HVG Allasborze (Jobline job fair) exhibitor lists
why_relevant: Twice-yearly national career fair; the exhibitor roster and the roles each bank/fintech advertises there is a compact, dated snapshot of who is in growth mode.

source_name: BankWeb.hu banki állás directory
why_relevant: Sector-specific HU directory linking bank career pages in one place - a cheap way to complete the inventory of smaller banks, savings co-ops and financial enterprises whose careers pages are otherwise hard to find.

source_name: Blockchain Magyarország Egyesület
why_relevant: Founded September 2018; the crypto/DLT-side professional body whose membership overlaps HU payment startups and PSP vendors. Useful for enumerating the digital-asset actor set that neither MAFISZ nor IVSZ fully covers; 'Rólunk' page is the officer/board entry point.

source_name: Clutch.co — Top Recruiting Firms in Hungary directory
why_relevant: A crowd-reviewed directory that enumerates HU recruiting and HR firms beyond the BBJ revenue list, including smaller boutique and fintech-focused shops the paid rankings miss. Reviews are self-selected and promotional, so use it purely as an actor-discovery pointer, not as an evidence source.

entity_name: ESMA / EU institutional CV and Board-of-Supervisors document archive
source_name: ESMA / EU institutional CV and Board-of-Supervisors document archive (Hungarian members)
why_relevant: Publishes English CVs of Hungarian supervisory appointees (e.g. an MNB executive director's CV filed with the ESMA Board of Supervisors) — an authoritative, English, machine-readable biography source that reveals appointments indirectly.

source_name: IIR Hungary – financial sector conferences
why_relevant: Long-running paid-conference organiser (Fraud & IT Security, risk, treasury). Archive pages persist for years, giving a historical title series for named bank managers — good for reconstructing career paths and dating role changes retroactively.

source_name: K-Monitor adatbázis — public-institution and state-bank entity dossiers
why_relevant: NGO-run tagged archive linking named individuals to state financial institutions across years of press and official documents. Not a primary register, but an efficient POINTER to the underlying official documents and to persons/roles at state banks that other cells would miss.

source_name: MAKISZ — Magyar Követeléskezelők és Üzleti Információt Szolgáltatók Szövetsége
why_relevant: Enumerates the debt-collection / business-information firms that sit downstream of every HU bank's NPL portfolio — an entity class absent from bank, fintech and IT association lists. The 'szovetseg' section carries the organisational description and officers.

source_name: MNV Zrt. (Hungarian National Asset Management) – közérdekű adatok
why_relevant: The state's asset manager: its portfolio lists and board-nomination records identify which financial entities are state-controlled and who sits on their boards. A pointer that keeps the actor map for this cell current as ownership moves between MNV, ministries and holding vehicles.

source_name: OMFIF Hungary meetings ("Hungary: a regional economic and financial centre")
why_relevant: International think-tank meeting pages give English-language, precisely-worded titles for MNB and Hungarian bank executives — valuable for normalising Hungarian titles to English equivalents and for catching senior appointments announced abroad first.

source_name: paytech.events – fintech/banking/payments conference calendar (Hungary entries)
why_relevant: Aggregator that catalogues Hungarian payments events (e.g. TechShow X 2026) with dates, venue and agenda summaries in English — the fastest way to discover event editions we do not yet track, then snowball to the organiser's own speaker page.

source_name: Shiwaforce.com — HU digital delivery partner, bank case studies
why_relevant: Published the Erste Bank Hungary cloud-migration case study, naming the programme and its scope. Local delivery partners' case-study pages are the main way a private bank's transformation team and its size become visible.

source_name: UNI Europa – Finance sector
why_relevant: European federation of ~100 finance-sector unions; useful pointer to identify which Hungarian bank unions are internationally affiliated, and a channel where cross-border restructuring (e.g. group-level integration at Erste, Raiffeisen, UniCredit) is contested and documented.

source_name: valantic — real-time payment engine case study, Erste Bank Hungary
why_relevant: Vendor case study documenting Erste Bank Hungary's instant-payments hub build. Instant-payment programme vendors are a reliable indirect indicator of payments-org restructuring at HU banks, which never announce such teams themselves.
